article_summaries.title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?
article_summaries.summary: This Spanish-titled page is a German-language summary of the Free Realms update notes for a 1 September update (the year is not printed; the page's 'published 2 years, 2 months ago' relative to the 2012 capture suggests about 2010). It lists new marketplace pet and Wugachug housing content plus a festival set of vendor and decor items, but gives no details beyond names.
